entities.summary: Darion Ray Atkins is an American professional basketball player for Maccabi Ironi Ramat Gan of the Israeli Basketball Premier League. He played college basketball for the University of Virginia before playing professionally in Israel, France and Germany. Standing at 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m), he primarily plays at the power forward and center positions.
